content.short: Koinly is crypto tax software that builds tax reports from your exchanges and wallets in minutes.
content.description: Koinly imports transactions from exchanges, wallets and DeFi activity, calculates gains and income, and produces tax reports such as Form 8949 and files for TurboTax, in more than 20 countries. It also suggests ways to reduce next year's tax bill. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists Koinly.
content.meta: Koinly is crypto tax software that turns exchange and wallet history into tax reports, listed for Unichain.
